scenes.narration: Coca-Cola made 47.9 billion dollars in 2025. But does it even make the bottles?
After all its costs, Coca-Cola kept 13.8 billion dollars of operating income.
Its own bottling arm kept only about 7 cents of every dollar it sold. The whole company kept almost 29.
Coke has been handing more bottling to partners, and that arm's revenue fell 8 percent in 2025.
Sell the syrup, and let partners handle the bottles.
